overview: This House resolution expresses the House's deep sorrow at the death of Richard B. Cheney, who served as Vice President of the United States. It directs the Clerk of the House to send the resolution to the Senate and a copy to his family, and it provides that the House adjourn for the day as a mark of respect. The House adopted it on November 12, 2025. It is ceremonial and does not change any law or spending.
for: Supporters say the resolution is a customary and fitting way for the House to honor a former Vice President and offer condolences to his family.
against: Critics say the resolution is ceremonial and does not change any law or spending.
